claims.claim: Q.ANT is a German company developing a chip that performs AI calculations using light waves instead of electricity.
claims.episode_span: A German company called Q.ANT has created a special chip that performs the hardest parts of AI math using light waves instead of the usual electrical signals.
claims.source_title: A New Breed of Chip Runs AI Models Using Waves of Light
claims.supporting_quote: German company Q.ANT is trying to cut the amount of energy required to run AI models by using light to perform the toughest calculations.
